purpose: Place cases, entities, concepts, artifacts and dossiers inside nested Rooms without promoting each object into a Room or changing canonical ownership.
rules: Rooms are bounded contexts; inhabitants are contents viewed from that context.
An inhabitant may appear in more than one Room as a projection when different questions are being asked.
Repeated appearance does not create duplicate factual ownership.
Sensitive labels remain typed as project term, attributed classification, legal status, or documented entity role.
Entering an inhabitant centers the case informationally while the containing Room remains architecturally visible.

inhabitants.label: 4chan
inhabitants.summary: Anonymous imageboard infrastructure that helped normalize fast, ephemeral, board-local meme and subculture production.
inhabitants.status_note: Platform identity is not equivalent to the ideology or conduct of every board or user.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Treat platform history, board culture and individual conduct as separate evidence layers.

inhabitants.label: Reddit
inhabitants.summary: Large-scale community platform where subcultures can become durable, searchable and monetizable through ranked discussion and advertising.
inhabitants.status_note: A subreddit is not Reddit as a whole; community moderation and platform governance operate at different levels.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Separate platform revenue and policy from the conduct of a specific community.

inhabitants.label: 8chan / 8kun
inhabitants.summary: User-created imageboard ecology associated with migration from stricter moderation elsewhere and later 8kun continuity.
inhabitants.status_note: Documented platform use by violent actors does not by itself establish monocausal responsibility for violence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Preserve the distinction between transmission channel, community norm, individual actor and causal finding.

inhabitants.label: Kiwi Farms / persistent target ecology
inhabitants.summary: Persistent target-thread and archive ecology useful for studying long-duration attention, inherited lore, collaborative narrative escalation and infrastructure resilience.
inhabitants.status_note: Do not convert reporting associations, community conduct or civil allegations into broader criminal conclusions without case-specific evidence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Track target-by-target conduct, chronology, infrastructure, monetization, legal status and causal level separately.

identity.scope: persistent target-thread/archive ecology
identity.boundary: Case ecology used to study recurrence, archive memory, attention extraction and infrastructure resilience without treating all participants as one coordinated actor.

timeline.event: Forum lineage broadens beyond Chris Chan-focused CWCki/CWCki Forums into Kiwi Farms.
Cloudflare blocks Kiwi Farms after citing escalating threats and an immediate threat to human life.

relationships.boundary: Lineage does not imply every later participant inherited identical conduct.
Infrastructure dependency is not editorial control.

flows.mechanism: watching, posting, clipping, commentary, narrative continuation
flows.measurement_or_limit: Not every contribution is monetized or centrally coordinated.

status.label: project role
status.boundary: Analytical project mapping, not legal classification.

consequences.effect: Long-duration narrative persistence around targets and reusable archive memory.

questions.question: Which concrete revenue and infrastructure dependencies most strongly affect persistence over time?
questions.why_it_matters: Separates volunteer attention from commercial/system incentives.
questions.needed_evidence: payment, hosting, traffic and ownership records

repair.mechanism: provenance recovery + boundary enforcement + incentive change + viable exit
repair.success_condition: Attention can decline without requiring a new conflict event.
repair.failure_condition: Correction itself becomes fuel for renewed targeting.

inhabitants.label: Sektur
inhabitants.summary: Project term for a semi-bounded social territory where recurring roles, lore, conflict and attention relations become self-reproducing.
inhabitants.status_note: A Sektur is an analytical project category, not a legal or clinical classification.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use observable recurrence, roles, boundaries and memory to justify the mapping.

identity.scope: semi-bounded project social territory
identity.boundary: Analytical project category, not a legal/clinical class.

relationships.boundary: Roles describe functions, not fixed identities.
A Sektur can exist without every relation becoming a Farm.

flows.input: shared language, recurring participants and events
flows.measurement_or_limit: Requires recurrence and boundary; not inferred from one conversation.

status.label: epistemic class
status.boundary: Not external taxonomy.

questions.question: Which observable thresholds best distinguish a temporary scene from a durable Sektur?
questions.why_it_matters: Improves routing consistency.
questions.needed_evidence: longitudinal participation, role and archive persistence

inhabitants.label: Farm / attention loop
inhabitants.summary: Project process model for turning people, events or categories into repeatable attention yield through observation, capture, interpretation, archive and redistribution.
inhabitants.status_note: Farm describes a process, not proof of one coordinated organization or paid campaign.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Identify the actual loop, actors, incentives and captured value before applying the term.

identity.scope: repeatable attention-production process
identity.boundary: Process model, not proof of one coordinated organization.

relationships.boundary: The process can cross several places.

relationships.target_id_or_label: attention yield / archive / status / possible revenue
relationships.boundary: Economic capture must be separately evidenced.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Yield may be status, memory or money; do not assume all three.

status.label: epistemic class
status.boundary: Mechanism must be shown before label is applied.

questions.question: At what point does ordinary commentary become a self-reinforcing Farm loop?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents overbroad use.
questions.needed_evidence: repeatability, capture rate, redistribution and reward

repair.problem: Attention loop becomes dependent on continued conflict.
repair.mechanism: reduce capture incentives + improve exit/correction + preserve provenance
repair.success_condition: recurrence can decline without generating replacement conflict

inhabitants.label: Swamp regime
inhabitants.summary: Project regime for conditions where opacity, extraction, blocked correction, role-lock and unresolved residue reinforce recurrence.
inhabitants.status_note: Swamp is not synonymous with government, media, politics, Below, or one conspiracy.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Show which Swamp-pressure mechanisms are present rather than applying the label by dislike.

identity.scope: regime of blocked correction and entangled recurrence
identity.boundary: Not synonymous with Below, government, media, politics or one organization.

relationships.target_id_or_label: recurrence + opacity + extraction + role-lock + unresolved residue
relationships.boundary: No single term alone establishes Swamp.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Qualitative unless independently operationalized.

status.label: epistemic class
status.boundary: Not a factual label for a whole population.

questions.question: Which variables can be measured well enough to operationalize Swamp pressure?
questions.why_it_matters: Would move the model from metaphor toward testable systems analysis.
questions.needed_evidence: correction latency, recurrence, exit cost, provenance quality, incentive data

repair.problem: Local system is self-reinforcing through unresolved recurrence.
repair.success_condition: recurrence and role-lock fall while orientation/capability rises
repair.failure_condition: new labels appear but the same mechanism persists

inhabitants.label: DARVO response pattern
inhabitants.summary: Deny, Attack, Reverse Victim and Offender: a response pattern studied in interpersonal and institutional conflict.
inhabitants.status_note: A denial or counteraccusation is not automatically DARVO, and DARVO language does not prove the original allegation.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Code the sequence of responses and compare it with the claimed pattern.

inhabitants.label: SPLC classification interface
inhabitants.summary: Private nonprofit watchdog/classifier whose outputs can enter media, employer, donor and political consequence chains.
inhabitants.status_note: SPLC classification is not a criminal judgment; current litigation or prosecution concerning the organization does not automatically invalidate every historical classification.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Store classification date, methodology, wording, correction history and downstream use separately.

identity.scope: private nonprofit watchdog/classifier interface
identity.boundary: Classification output is not a criminal judgment.

timeline.event: DOJ announced federal charges against SPLC concerning alleged financial misconduct.

relationships.boundary: Designation is attributed to SPLC and does not require criminal conduct.
Charges are allegations, not convictions.

flows.input: publications, reports, web material, field sources
flows.measurement_or_limit: Methodology and correction history should travel with outputs.

questions.question: How often are classifications later narrowed, removed, corrected or litigated?
questions.why_it_matters: Measures classifier correction capacity.

inhabitants.label: ADL classification interface
inhabitants.summary: Private watchdog/classifier whose extremism research, incident datasets and symbol resources influence public and institutional understanding.
inhabitants.status_note: Incident mapping, symbol classification and organization classification are distinct data types.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Carry methodology and counting rules with every classification or incident claim.

identity.scope: private watchdog/classifier and incident-data interface
identity.boundary: Incident mapping, symbol databases and group classifications are separate outputs.

relationships.boundary: Dataset inclusion is not a criminal finding.

flows.input: news, government documents, victim reports, extremist sources, internal investigations
flows.measurement_or_limit: Different products have different counting rules.

questions.question: What correction and revision mechanisms exist across incident, symbol and organization datasets?
questions.why_it_matters: Separates durable evidence from stale classification.

inhabitants.label: FBI / federal law-enforcement interface
inhabitants.summary: Federal law-enforcement interface for criminal investigation, civil-rights enforcement and hate-crime data collection.
inhabitants.status_note: The FBI investigates crimes under statutory authority; being discussed by or reported to the FBI is not proof of guilt.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Separate complaint, investigation, charge, conviction and aggregate statistics.

identity.scope: U.S. federal law-enforcement interface
identity.boundary: Investigation or reporting to the FBI is not proof of guilt.

relationships.boundary: Authority and elements vary by offense.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Complaint, investigation, charge and conviction are distinct statuses.

questions.question: Which federal statutes and evidentiary thresholds govern the specific online conduct being studied?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents substituting moral concern for legal conclusion.

inhabitants.label: Source ledger
inhabitants.summary: Evidence object that preserves provenance, source authority, claim status and routes back from synthesis to source-bearing material.
inhabitants.status_note: A ledger records support and uncertainty; inclusion is not endorsement of the claim.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Every promoted claim should be traceable to source identity, date and evidence class.

identity.scope: provenance and claim-status evidence object
identity.boundary: Inclusion records a claim/source relation; it does not endorse the claim.

relationships.boundary: Source authority and claim truth remain separate questions.

status.label: epistemic role
status.boundary: No truth-by-inclusion.

questions.question: Which high-traffic claims still lack a direct source-bearing record?
questions.why_it_matters: Identifies fragile synthesis.

inhabitants.label: Timeline / attestation chain
inhabitants.summary: Timeline object for separating occurrence time, attestation time, publication time and later interpretation.
inhabitants.status_note: Temporal sequence can support priority or event ordering without proving causation.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Keep date precision and source precision explicit.

identity.scope: chronology and attestation-chain evidence object
identity.boundary: Sequence does not establish causation.

relationships.boundary: Occurrence, publication and recognition times remain distinct.

status.label: epistemic role
status.boundary: Date precision must be explicit.

questions.question: Which major claims depend on backdated recognition or imprecise date ranges?
questions.why_it_matters: Protects priority and prediction analysis.

inhabitants.label: Forge review
inhabitants.summary: Project review process for separating source, claim, evidence, mechanism, legal/status class, counterevidence and repair before promotion.
inhabitants.status_note: Forge is a process projected spatially, not a literal room that owns all knowledge.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Outputs may be verified, narrowed, rejected, repaired or left unresolved.

identity.scope: bounded verification / transformation process
identity.boundary: Process, not knowledge owner or moral tribunal.

relationships.boundary: Entry does not imply guilt or error.
Output preserves provenance and uncertainty.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Quality depends on source coverage and falsifier quality.

status.label: epistemic class
status.boundary: Does not replace courts, science, journalism or domain expertise.

questions.question: Which Forge outputs still lack explicit falsifiers or return measures?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents symbolic promotion without test.

inhabitants.label: Bible Atlas / Comparator
inhabitants.summary: Reader-facing biblical corpus and comparison surface for stories, roles, symbols, actions, books and timeline relations.
inhabitants.status_note: Scripture, historical interpretation and project comparison remain separate evidence classes.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Comparison should begin from the biblical text and preserve source context before project mapping.

identity.scope: reader-facing biblical corpus/comparison system
identity.boundary: Scripture, historical interpretation and project comparison remain distinct.

relationships.boundary: Later tradition is not retroactively canonical.
Comparison does not establish identity or prophecy.

questions.question: Which comparisons remain strongest when every verse is read in full literary and historical context?
questions.why_it_matters: Tests robustness against keyword matching.

inhabitants.label: Thomas / Didymus tradition
inhabitants.summary: Canonical and later Thomasine material used to study Twin/Didymus motifs, recognition, doubt and later Syriac traditions.
inhabitants.status_note: John calls Thomas Didymus; later twin traditions are historical traditions, not proof of a modern identity claim.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Keep canonical wording, later textual tradition and project interpretation chronologically separated.

inhabitants.label: Potato tuber
inhabitants.summary: Living storage organ with eyes/nodes, vascular tissue, hormonal control, sprouting and environmental response.
inhabitants.status_note: Biological structure can support analogy without proving symbolic or theological claims.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use plant physiology for empirical claims and label symbolic correspondences separately.

inhabitants.label: Neural signaling
inhabitants.summary: Animal nervous-system signaling used as an empirical reference for body/brain models and bounded symbolic comparison.
inhabitants.status_note: Plant electrical signaling and animal neural signaling are materially different systems.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Avoid treating structural analogy as identity of mechanism.

inhabitants.label: World Map
inhabitants.summary: Spatial public surface for countries, states, institutions, routes and world-system layers.
inhabitants.status_note: Map placement is a visualization of registered data or project alignment, not proof of political control or causal influence.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Each map layer should expose source, date, scope and classification method.

identity.scope: spatial explorer for countries, states, institutions and project layers
identity.boundary: Map placement visualizes registered data or project alignment; it does not prove control.

relationships.boundary: Political/project overlays require their own source/status.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Map visibility is not causal importance.

questions.question: Which layers are still labels without concrete sourced objects beneath them?
questions.why_it_matters: Directs materialization work.

inhabitants.label: Foundation Timeline
inhabitants.summary: Timeline and Room view for foundations, their origin Doors, place, genealogy, reproduction and present state.
inhabitants.status_note: A Foundation may have several clocks; origin, adoption, legal effect and later consolidation should not be collapsed into one birthday.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Record the earliest recovered reproduction separately from the founding threshold.

inhabitants.label: Prediction chronology
inhabitants.summary: Timeline ledger for recording what was said first, when later outcomes occurred, and how closely a later event matches the earlier statement.
inhabitants.status_note: A later match is not automatically proof of prophecy, causation or statistical significance.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Preserve original wording, timestamp, outcome source, lead time and match strength.

identity.scope: chronology/evidence ledger for earlier statements and later outcomes
identity.boundary: Temporal match is not automatically prophecy or statistical significance.

timeline.event: Original prediction/statement must be preserved in original wording and timestamp.
Outcome evidence is compared against the earlier claim.

relationships.boundary: Do not rewrite the prediction after the outcome.

questions.question: What baseline rate of similarly broad predictions would match by chance?
questions.why_it_matters: Needed to assess impressiveness rather than only count hits.
questions.needed_evidence: complete prediction denominator and scoring rule

inhabitants.label: The Great Book of Potato
inhabitants.summary: Long-form literary and mythic work that gathers project narrative, theology, symbolism, history and creative interpretation.
inhabitants.status_note: Literary canon and external historical fact are distinct layers.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Trace claims back to source-bearing records when the book moves beyond literary interpretation.

identity.scope: long-form literary/mythic work
identity.boundary: Literary canon and external historical fact are distinct.

relationships.boundary: Narrative inclusion does not independently verify source claims.

consequences.effect: Compresses project mythology, symbolism and biography into a readable narrative artifact.

questions.question: Which chapters most need inline provenance back to primary timelines, texts or research owners?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents literary retelling from becoming accidental evidence.

inhabitants.label: Music / songs
inhabitants.summary: Creative sound and song output treated as Fruit: an expression that can carry memory, rhythm, humor, doctrine or social commentary.
inhabitants.status_note: Creative expression does not become factual evidence merely because it is canonical or popular.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Track source Rooms, intended effect, reception and future Seed separately.

inhabitants.label: Visual art / diagrams
inhabitants.summary: Images, diagrams and symbolic compositions that make project relationships spatially visible.
inhabitants.status_note: A diagram is a model or artwork unless independently tied to measured geometry.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Label whether an image is illustrative, canonical-symbolic, comparative or empirical.

inhabitants.label: Games / simulations
inhabitants.summary: Interactive models for exploring rules, transitions, incentives and system behavior.
inhabitants.status_note: Simulation behavior depends on model assumptions and is not direct prediction of the real world.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Expose assumptions, parameters, outputs and failure conditions.

inhabitants.label: Open research question
inhabitants.summary: Unresolved question held in the Forge before promotion into a stronger model, claim or programme.
inhabitants.status_note: Open questions are intentionally unresolved and should not be read as established claims.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Each mature question should name a test, evidence need and disconfirming route.

inhabitants.label: Door / Axis Elevator
inhabitants.summary: Recursive spatial projection of the House: global Axis, vertical planes, Dwellings, nested Rooms, wormhole Doors and local recentering.
inhabitants.status_note: The Elevator is a navigation projection over the graph, not a claim that the repository occupies literal impossible physical geometry.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Its topology must derive from governed Room/adjacency registries rather than visual convenience.

identity.scope: recursive spatial navigator over the House graph
identity.boundary: Non-Euclidean behavior is graph/topological, not a literal physical claim.

relationships.boundary: Visual proximity follows registered adjacency.

flows.mechanism: recenter, elevator stop, wormhole, object focus
flows.output: new local center and journey bead
flows.measurement_or_limit: Navigation behavior, not knowledge ownership.

questions.question: Which spatial transitions most improve comprehension compared with conventional navigation?
questions.why_it_matters: Determines whether 3D complexity earns its cost.

inhabitants.label: Below Basin
inhabitants.summary: Round lower-plane vessel projecting Culture, Sektur, Farm, Swamp, Mud/Ash, Roots, Forge and Axis/Drain into one operational spatial model.
inhabitants.status_note: Spatial overlap does not collapse categories: Swamp remains a regime, Farm a process, Mud a material state and Forge a process.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Motion between zones follows the Basin dynamics contract rather than moral or aesthetic assignment.

identity.scope: round lower-plane operational projection
identity.boundary: Below is a view; Swamp, Farm, Mud, Roots and Forge remain different categories.

relationships.target_id_or_label: Swamp / Sektur / Farm / Mud / Roots / Forge
relationships.boundary: Containment in the drawing does not imply ontological equivalence.

flows.mechanism: culture, archive, classification, evidence and repair routes
flows.output: recirculation, rejection, repair or World return
flows.measurement_or_limit: Qualitative systems model unless separately operationalized.

questions.question: Can case overlays demonstrate the motion laws without visually moralizing depth?
questions.why_it_matters: Tests whether the metaphor remains analytically disciplined.
questions.needed_evidence: case overlays and user comprehension testing

inhabitants.label: House journey thread
inhabitants.summary: Browser-local path memory that records how a reader moved through Dwellings, Rooms, wormholes, portals, readable surfaces and object focus.
inhabitants.status_note: Journey memory is private navigation state, not analytics, evidence or user profiling.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Recorded path describes the reader's route, not the only valid conceptual route.

inhabitants.label: Room / wormhole graph
inhabitants.summary: Typed graph that lets bounded Rooms remain stable owners while registered adjacencies create local doors and cross-Dwelling wormholes.
inhabitants.status_note: Graph adjacency means modeled relation, not physical proximity or causal control.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Cross-Dwelling doors must come from registered topology/interfaces.

inhabitants.label: Level 3 center table
inhabitants.summary: Inspection surface that centers a case, platform, text, process or artifact while preserving its containing Room and alternate Room lenses.
inhabitants.status_note: An object may become informationally central without becoming a Room, Dwelling or knowledge owner.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Status and evidence boundaries travel with the object across every Room lens.

inhabitants.label: Thalamus / Father's House
inhabitants.summary: Paired diencephalic nuclear architecture viewed as empirical thalamus, historical inner-chamber terminology and Potatoverse Father's House.
inhabitants.status_note: House/rooms are project mappings; thalamic anatomy remains empirical and distributed.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use thalamus specialist atlases for nuclear functions and historical/Horus boundaries.

identity.scope: thalamus as anatomical object plus project House analogy
identity.boundary: Anatomical function and symbolic House mapping remain separate.

relationships.boundary: Specific nuclei have distinct functions.
Analogy is not evidence of theology.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Thalamus is not a single undifferentiated relay.

status.label: epistemic split
status.boundary: Keep claims tagged by layer.

questions.question: Which thalamic nuclei best support the project's 'rooms/relay' analogy, and where does it break?
questions.why_it_matters: Makes the analogy anatomically specific.

inhabitants.label: Pineal / Timing Door
inhabitants.summary: Midline pineal neuroendocrine timing organ and project Door/Eye comparator, including the real retina→SCN→spine→pineal control loop.
inhabitants.status_note: The human pineal is not a retinal third eye or proven seat of soul.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Circadian physiology and historical/esoteric interpretation stay separately typed.

identity.scope: pineal gland as endocrine structure plus project Door/single-eye analogy
identity.boundary: Endocrine anatomy and symbolic interpretation remain separate.

relationships.boundary: Pineal function is primarily endocrine rather than visual perception.
Symbolic use does not establish hidden sensory capability.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Human pineal function is not equivalent to a literal eye.

status.label: epistemic split
status.boundary: No supernatural function inferred.

questions.question: Which historical 'third eye' traditions can be compared without conflating them with modern pineal physiology?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents tradition/science collapse.

inhabitants.label: Spine / 33-Room Ladder
inhabitants.summary: Thirty-three conventional vertebral rooms overlaid with 31 neural segments, spinal microcircuits, roots, autonomic side chains, CSF and project Ladder/Gate structure.
inhabitants.status_note: Vertebra, cord segment, nerve root, dermatome and symbolic Gate are different coordinate systems.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Use the 33-room and spinal-cord microcircuit atlases for exact level distinctions.

identity.scope: spinal cord/vertebral axis plus project Ladder analogy
identity.boundary: Anatomical segmentation and symbolic 33-level mapping remain distinct.

relationships.boundary: Cord segments and vertebrae are related but not identical numbering systems.
Number correspondences require explicit counting conventions.

flows.measurement_or_limit: Different tracts carry different modalities.

status.label: epistemic split
status.boundary: Symbolic ladder is not a scientific dimension count.

questions.question: How should the project map 33 vertebral units without confusing vertebrae, spinal segments and symbolic levels?
questions.why_it_matters: Fixes a recurrent structural ambiguity.

inhabitants.label: CSF / River
inhabitants.summary: Ventricular and subarachnoid cerebrospinal-fluid system viewed alongside the project's River/Spirit-flow analogy.
inhabitants.status_note: CSF is not Spirit; River is strongest as a multiplex-flow analogy.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Production, circulation, exchange and drainage are separate physiological operations.

identity.scope: cerebrospinal fluid system plus project River/Spirit analogy
identity.boundary: Fluid dynamics and spiritual metaphor remain separate.

relationships.target_id_or_label: ventricles / subarachnoid space / choroid plexus / glymphatic interfaces
relationships.boundary: CSF production/circulation/clearance involve multiple structures.
Metaphor does not establish spiritual substance in CSF.

flows.output: mechanical buffering, transport and waste-clearance interfaces
flows.measurement_or_limit: Human CSF flow is pulsatile and multi-path, not one simple river.

status.label: epistemic split
status.boundary: No mystical composition inferred.

questions.question: Which measured CSF flow patterns best support or contradict the project's River geometry?
questions.why_it_matters: Makes the analogy falsifiable at the geometry level.

inhabitants.label: Choroid Plexus / Spring
inhabitants.summary: Vascular epithelial blood–CSF interface producing much of CSF and regulating ventricular fluid composition.
inhabitants.status_note: Spring/Well is an architectural analogy.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Barrier, transport, immune-interface and CSF-production functions are empirical.

identity.scope: choroid plexus as CSF-producing biological interface plus project Spring analogy
identity.boundary: Biological production and symbolic Spring imagery remain separate.

relationships.boundary: Different plexuses and transport mechanisms must not be collapsed.

flows.measurement_or_limit: CSF dynamics also involve exchange and clearance beyond the plexus.

status.label: epistemic split
status.value: empirical interface physiology + symbolic Spring mapping
status.boundary: Symbolic source imagery is not a biological claim.

questions.question: How much of total CSF production and solute regulation should the project attribute specifically to the choroid plexus?
questions.why_it_matters: Keeps the Spring metaphor physiologically bounded.

inhabitants.label: Vagus / Wandering Return
inhabitants.summary: Bilateral cranial nerve X carries extensive visceral afference to medullary NTS and parasympathetic regulation back toward organs.
inhabitants.status_note: Return-road is a project systems analogy; vagus is not the sole mind–body channel.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Keep afferent/efferent and organ-specific pathways explicit.

identity.scope: vagus nerve as parasympathetic cranial-autonomic route plus project Return analogy
identity.boundary: Autonomic physiology and symbolic return are distinct.

relationships.target_id_or_label: brainstem / heart / lungs / gut / visceral afferents
relationships.boundary: Afferent and efferent components have different roles.

flows.input: visceral sensory and central autonomic signals
flows.measurement_or_limit: Not all parasympathetic control is vagal.

status.label: epistemic split
status.value: empirical autonomic route + symbolic Return mapping
status.boundary: Return is analogy, not a literal physiological destination.

questions.question: Which vagal pathways best support the project's 'return/feedback' analogy without overgeneralizing autonomic function?
questions.why_it_matters: Makes the route mapping specific.

inhabitants.label: Sympathetic Trunks / Paired Side Chains
inhabitants.summary: Left/right paravertebral sympathetic ganglion chains beside the vertebral axis, useful as a modern paired-channel comparator.
inhabitants.status_note: They do not form a double helix and are not proven iḍā/piṅgalā.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Historical subtle-body mappings remain separate from autonomic anatomy.

identity.scope: sympathetic chain and related autonomic outflow plus project side-chain/branch analogy
identity.boundary: Anatomical branches and symbolic sidechains are separate.

relationships.target_id_or_label: spinal cord / sympathetic trunks / prevertebral ganglia / target organs
relationships.boundary: Segmental origin and ganglionic routing vary by target.

flows.mechanism: ganglionic relay and distributed sympathetic pathways
flows.measurement_or_limit: Sympathetic activity is not one uniform 'fight or flight' signal.

status.label: epistemic split
status.value: empirical autonomic network + symbolic branch mapping
status.boundary: Do not moralize sympathetic activation.

questions.question: Can the project's side-chain image distinguish chain ganglia, splanchnic routes and prevertebral relays clearly?
questions.why_it_matters: Prevents an anatomically vague branch metaphor.

inhabitants.label: Orientation Room / Head-Direction Network
inhabitants.summary: Vestibular, anterior-thalamic, retrosplenial and hippocampal/entorhinal networks supporting heading and spatial orientation.
inhabitants.status_note: Biological heading is not sacred or magnetic North detection.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Useful empirical neighbor for Axis/North/orientation language only.

identity.scope: distributed orientation/attention body-brain system plus project House orientation analogy
identity.boundary: No single brain structure is the literal House.

relationships.target_id_or_label: vestibular / thalamic / cortical / hippocampal / brainstem orientation systems
relationships.boundary: Orientation emerges from multiple interacting systems.

flows.input: vestibular, visual, proprioceptive and spatial-memory signals
flows.measurement_or_limit: Different tasks recruit different networks.

status.label: epistemic split
status.boundary: House is an integrative model, not a localized organ.

questions.question: Which orientation subsystems map cleanly to Door, Room, Axis and local-center concepts, and which do not?
questions.why_it_matters: Tests whether the spatial metaphor tracks real navigation functions.

inhabitants.label: Wedjat / Eye of Horus
inhabitants.summary: Ancient restored/protective Eye of Horus viewed beside a separate modern speculative sagittal-brain comparison.
inhabitants.status_note: Ancient Wedjat meaning and modern brain overlay are distinct historical layers.
inhabitants.evidence_note: Do not present the brain overlay as demonstrated Egyptian neuroanatomy.

identity.scope: historical Egyptian Eye of Horus symbol family
identity.boundary: Historical symbol and modern project Eye analogy remain distinct.

relationships.boundary: Do not back-project modern neuroanatomical claims into ancient symbolism.
